event_text: AEON's online services and app go into 'system maintenance'
notes: Time given only as 'evening'; 6 PM HK time is our placeholder for the start.

event_text: Dimsum Daily reports the portal and app still down, more than 40 hours after the outage began
notes: From Dimsum Daily's Nov 20 article. Corrected Nov 22: this was earlier dated Nov 21.

event_text: Online services and the app come back, The Standard and Metro Radio report
